home.heroSubtitle: Kit de desktop para downloads de áudio IA, captura de mídia, edição de metadados e análise de Tom e BPM.
home.sunoDesc: Baixe faixas Suno AI em MP3 320k, WAV sem perdas, fluxo original, capa em alta resolução e letra sincronizada.
home.universalDesc: Baixe vídeos em MP4 e áudio em MP3 do Instagram, YouTube, TikTok e Facebook em um clique.
home.metadataDesc: Edite título, artista, álbum e capa de arquivos MP3, WAV, FLAC e M4A.
home.detectorDesc: Análise harmônica para detectar o tom musical (roda Camelot) e o tempo (BPM) em segundos.
home.tipDragDrop: Você pode arrastar e soltar arquivos de áudio diretamente na janela.
home.tipCoverArt: Use imagens JPG ou PNG para a capa no editor de metadados.
home.tipOffline: Todas as análises e conversões são executadas localmente no seu dispositivo sem envio à internet.
home.cutterDesc: Trim seamless 8-second audio samples from your tracks for Suno and music production.
home.rel1Desc: Interactive audio waveform with a fixed 8-second sliding window for seamless Suno sample trims (320k MP3 / WAV).
home.rel2Desc: Studio 320k MP3, WAV, cover art, and lyrics. Universal media capture with categorizable history.
home.rel3Desc: 12-Chroma HPCP with Camelot wheel, harmonic mixing pairs, and fine BPM adjustments.
home.rel4Desc: Resolved search bar icon text collision, customizable folder routing, and official v1.0 release.

settings.aboutDesc: Kit de ferramentas de desktop para downloads de áudio e mídia.
settings.foldersDesc: Customize destination folders individually for each download type.
settings.accentColorDesc: Pick any custom color via the color wheel.
settings.relSunoDesc: Download Suno tracks as 320k MP3, uncompressed WAV, original stream, cover art, and synced lyrics (.lrc/.txt). Left slide-over history drawer with instant search.
settings.relUniDesc: One-click MP4 video & MP3 audio conversion from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X and more. Sortable (A-Z, date) and filterable media history.
settings.relEssentiaDesc: High-accuracy Camelot key detection with 12-Chroma HPCP, harmonic mixing matches, half/double tempo, and precision BPM fine-tuning.
settings.relMetaDesc: Edit song title, artist, album, and year for MP3, WAV, FLAC, and M4A files; swap album art instantly and embed tags via ID3v2.4 directly.
settings.relFolderDesc: Separate destination paths for All (.zip), Audio, Cover Art, Lyrics, and Universal Media. Offline Manrope typography, 6 accent colors, 3 theme modes, and 8 languages.
